subject.summary: Approximate measured reconstruction of an early double-stroke Leica M3 with the original collapsible 50 mm Summicron. Opening presents manual lens extension and an illustrative locking twist, not an automatic camera mechanism.

sources.title: Public showcase commission
sources.ref: Leica M3 (1954), collapsible 50 mm Summicron extends on presentation opening; no reference images or assigned palette.

sources.title: Leitz Auction A02280, M3 700074 with Summicron 1115548
KJ Vogelius: collapsible Summicron specifications and operation
Summicron optical schematic, not a prescription
Reconstruction studio presentation design
sources.ref: Assembly, quiet scan, camera tour, lock-turn angle and animation timing are decorative choices.
